title: Meiosis Stages Explorer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AP Biology
description: Interactive diagram overlay showing all stages of meiosis I and meiosis II with 16 callout markers, featuring Explore and Quiz modes.

learningObjectives: Identify each stage of meiosis I and meiosis II by chromosome appearance
Describe the key events and chromosome behavior at each stage
Explain how crossing over and independent assortment generate genetic variation
Distinguish between what separates in anaphase I vs anaphase II
standards: AP Biology Unit 11: Meiosis and Mendelian Genetics

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Interactive exploration with callout markers and quiz mode
keyQuestions: What separates in anaphase I vs anaphase II?
How does crossing over create recombinant chromosomes?
Why does independent assortment produce 2^n possible gamete combinations?
What is nondisjunction and what conditions does it cause?
commonMisconceptions: Students confuse what separates in anaphase I (homologs) vs anaphase II (sister chromatids)
Students think DNA replication occurs between meiosis I and meiosis II
Students believe crossing over and independent assortment are the same thing
Students forget that meiosis I is reductional (2n to n) while meiosis II is equational (n to n)
assessmentOpportunities: Quiz mode: identify all 16 structures and concepts by clicking correct markers
Compare meiosis I and meiosis II side by side
Explain sources of genetic variation in meiosis
